auth.note: If the server needs a key, name an environment variable in key_env under [engine]; sent as x-api-key with anthropic-version.

verified.notes: Any server with Anthropic's model list (GET /v1/models answering with a data list and has_more) and POST /v1/messages. The gateway passes /v1/messages (and /v1/messages/count_tokens, falling back locally on 404) straight through, and translates /v1/chat/completions and /v1/responses to /v1/messages and back. Exercised through ezbx gateway serve with the fake engine in Anthropic mode.
